text:
QUOTE: `archiveChannel`: "Removes the current user from the channel locally" when `'false'`; websocket handler: "If the user is viewing it, kicks them out with `CHANNEL_ARCHIVED`, then removes the membership"; viewable: "Sets local `delete_at` so the channel stays visible as archived" / "Keeps the archived channel in the local DB"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The table states that non-viewable removes the user (and kicks them out if viewing the channel), while viewable keeps the channel and sets `delete_at`, which marks it deleted.
